note: Re-judged 2026-10-16: both units changed only by package qualification. The plugin unit now calls core flowspec.ParseFlowSpec and flowspec.KwDestinationIPv6; the firewall unit names the IPv6 FlowSpec family as a family.Family literal. RFC 8956 Section 3.1: "If length = 0 and offset = 0, this component matches every address; otherwise, length MUST be in the range offset < length < 129 or the component is malformed." First clause: flowspec-firewall TestRFC8956ZeroLengthZeroOffsetMatchesEveryAddress parses 03 01 00 00 and 03 02 00 00 and requires the firewall matches to be exactly MatchDestinationAddress{::/0} and MatchSourceAddress{::/0}. Its containment loop checks the constant and adds nothing, so the require.Equal is the proof. Second clause: TestIPv6FlowPrefixRejectsMalformedBounds requires parse errors for 0/1, 64/64, 63/64, 129/0 and a truncated pattern, and config refusal for /64/64, /64/65 and /0/1. It also requires 80/64 to encode and compare equal to its received form.
